steps.en: Install the CLI and the lint/format plugins you want as dev dependencies
steps.zh: 把命令行和想要的 lint、格式化插件装成开发依赖

steps.en: List the plugins, their order and stringify settings in package.json
steps.zh: 在 package.json 里列出插件、顺序和输出设置

steps.en: Run remark over the project and let it rewrite files
steps.zh: 对整个项目跑 remark，允许它改写文件

steps.en: Parses every Markdown file into an mdast syntax tree
steps.zh: 把每个 Markdown 文件解析成 mdast 语法树

steps.en: Runs the plugins in order: lint rules report, transforms like remark-toc change the tree
steps.zh: 按顺序跑插件：lint 规则报警告，remark-toc 之类的变换改树

steps.en: Serializes each tree back to Markdown, writes the files and prints warnings with line:column
steps.zh: 把树序列化回 Markdown 写进文件，并按行列号打印警告

value.en: Every Markdown file follows one style and its generated parts stay current, without hand edits
value.zh: 所有 Markdown 文件统一风格、生成的部分自动更新，不用手改

sources: https://github.com/remarkjs/remark#example-checking-and-formatting-markdown-on-the-cli (npm install --save-dev remark-cli remark-preset-lint-consistent remark-preset-lint-recommended remark-toc; "format": "remark . --output"; remarkConfig plugins/settings)
https://github.com/remarkjs/remark#syntax (micromark parsing) and #what-is-this (remark-parse / remark-stringify / remark-cli packages)
